proposals.evidence: The full mr̥ttikā entry gives Assamese, Bengali and Oriya māṭi “earth, soil, clay”, alongside Prakrit mattiyā/maṭṭiā. These eastern soil responses match the complete regional māṭi family, with survey dental t versus retroflex ṭ notation preserved. This family link leaves interlanguage transmission open; Turner’s separate uncertainty over Shina māṭi is not generalized to these eastern forms.
